summary: Iteration 2: Validated new Tutup Kasir (daily cash closing) and Excel Export features. Added 12 new backend pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_cash_and_export.py; combined with existing regression suite 41/41 pass. Playwright UI smoke verified kasir and owner flows for /tutup-kasir and /laporan/* export buttons with real xlsx download.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_cash._period_start computes period_start as 'start of today' when there is no previous closing. In Asia/Jakarta that's correct, but any closing done after 00:00 WIB will cause the first closing of a NEW day to still start from the previous closing's period_end (which is yesterday's close time). This is actually desired per spec (continuous shift chain), so OK. Just document behavior.

routes_cash.close_cash uses s['period_end'] (now_iso()) as created_at — this is fine. It stores period_start/period_end from the summary dict via **s which also includes 'count','total', etc. Ensure CashClosing model only accepts expected keys (potential strict-model risk). Current code relies on the model being permissive; worth adding explicit field passing to avoid future breakage.
routes_export._subtitle calls get_settings() per export — minor overhead; could cache. Not a bug.
routes_export export_closings endpoint is owner-only (OWNER dep). Good. METHOD_LABEL ordering is deterministic (python 3.7+ dict preserves insertion), aligning column headers with values.
ClosingForm.jsx conditionally renders cash-difference block only after counted is filled; acceptable UX. Tests should fill counted before asserting this testid.
Download filenames use today's local period when start/end omitted (observed: laporan-penjualan_2026-10-15_2026-10-15.xlsx) - correct.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates a few TEST_-prefixed sales and 1-2 TK-* closings per user (both kasir and owner). Sale decrements stock on demo items 200000000001..200000000004. Owner's closing used opening=50000 counted=50000. Running the suite repeatedly will accumulate closings; cleanup is not performed because closings have no DELETE endpoint (acceptable - they're ledger entries).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 2 features (cash closing + xlsx export) work end-to-end. Playwright UI test: use first <input> for username (no name/testid), input[type=password] for password, button:has-text('Masuk') for submit. For /tutup-kasir, cash-difference is only rendered after counted field is non-empty. Downloads tested via page.expect_download. If re-running playwright tests, note that running the owner close flow leaves a TK-* closing dialog open - close it or navigate away first. Backend tests are parallel-safe (pytest-xdist LoadScope). Server is up at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env.
